name: Grendel

crownPassive.name: Night raid
crownPassive.text: At upkeep, deal 2 damage to the enemy front-rank card with the lowest health.

bond.text: While a Grendel's Mother on your side lives, he heals 1 at upkeep.
bond.name: His mother's mere

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Devour
actions.text: Destroy an enemy front-rank card on 2 health or less and heal 2.

rules: Grendel and Grendel's Mother are a pair: they are drawn together and must be fielded together.
